chunks: "The Compeller, Glorious is His Majesty, says: Indeed, a servant to whom I have done good and upon whom I have bestowed favor, then he does not visit Me in this place every five years, is surely deprived."

key_terms.أَحْسَنْتُ: I have done good; referring to Allah's beneficence
key_terms.الْجَبَّارَ: The Almighty Compeller, one of the divine attributes of Allah
key_terms.الْمَكَانِ: This place; referring to the Ka'bah or the Sacred House
key_terms.جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ: Glorious is His Majesty; a formula of exaltation for Allah
key_terms.لَمَحْرُومٌ: Surely deprived; one deprived of great blessing
key_terms.يَزُرْنِي: He visits Me; meaning visiting the Sacred House for hajj

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about visiting the Ka'bah every five years?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the great virtue of hajj and visiting the Sacred House for one who has been granted the means and blessings by Allah. It portrays neglecting such a visit over a long period as a sign of deprivation from divine bounty.
